sources.primary_title: Mannai Information Technology to highlight future of sports, smart cities, enterprises through AI and digital innovation at LEAP
sources.verified_angle_summary: Mannai Information Technology Saudi Arabia (MIT KSA), a part of Mannai Corporation, has announced its participation in LEAP 2026. The company is set to showcase its latest AI-powered innovations tailored for connected stadiums, smart cities, and enterprises. This move aligns with Saudi Arabia's Vision 2030, which emphasizes technological advancement and economic diversification. Following the recent opening of its regional headquarters in Riyadh, MIT KSA aims to leverage AI, cloud computing, and digital infrastructure to support the Kingdom's growing sports industry, including preparations for the FIFA World Cup 2034. The angle focuses specifically on how Mannai IT is positioning itself as a key technology partner in Saudi Arabia's digital future, highlighting practical, outcome-driven solutions over standalone technologies. This specific focus on smart city and connected stadium infrastructure makes it a distinct and newsworthy angle for LEAP 2026 coverage.
